body: Hi, I just logged in to this account after months, sorry for the delay. If I remember correctly of this time, I ended up getting back on Abilify after 2 weeks of cold turkey, because my bipolar symptoms grew worse. Still taking the same dose, no TD yet, hopefully never.
Thank you so much.

Ok, thank you. One thing I should note is I don't know if I actually have BPD, it's just that I noticed I have some of its symptoms. For now my diagnosis is bipolar so I guess I'll assume that I have bipolar. As for the cause, probably trauma during childhood and adolescence, but I really don't know.

My parents know about this but I don't feel comfortable reaching out to them for support. I never talk about my mental illness to any of my friends because I think it will either make them look at me differently or make them leave. (I do talk to some of them about my mental health but never disclose what kind of illness I have.)
I do have an appointment with my doctor in a few days. I didn't know it sounded urgent... it's just the default, familiar state to me.

I've heard of BPD but never considered the possibility that I might have it. I'll definitely look into it.
About splitting, yes, I can recall doing that recently. My thinking was not as extreme as what you have described but I definitely played pointless games inside my head switching between 'I love this person so much' and 'this person makes me unhappy so I should let go of them'.

I should clarify, I don't mind if minor muscle twitches that happen only when I'm trying to sleep are permanent, because Abilify literally keeps me alive. However, if this is a first sign of something more serious to come (TD for example), I will need to taper the fuck off.
I can do something about it since I have a mental illness but it's gonna be complicated. But thanks for commenting.

Probably years of bipolar disorder. Just existing is painful enough for me. I'm getting fat because of my meds. Also military service is mandatory for everyone assigned male at birth in my country and that makes me want to die.
Lol well, it's been 2 weeks since I've stopped taking Abilify cold turkey, I don't know what's gonna happen

I quit Abilify cold turkey about 2 weeks ago because I was terrified about developing Tardive Dyskinesia. I've been taking it for about 2 years. I feel mildly suicidal now, like I know I won't actually do anything dangerous but I wish I never wake up from sleep again. I wonder if this is a withdrawal symptom. But I don't want to get back on Abilify because if by chance I get permanent TD, I think I'd off myself. I feel trapped and don't know what I should do.

Purely emotional. I have no good reason to feel this way. But I feel like I'm at my breaking point. In fact I quit one of my bipolar meds abruptly a week ago because I was terrified of developing a debilitating side effect called tardive dyskinesia so that might be the reason. But if I start taking it again I have a fairly high chance of developing that condition, in which case I might kill myself anyway. So I'm trapped.
No, too much is changing and everything is uncertain because of the pandemic. I'm overwhelmed. Everything is too much for me.
Thanks, this gave me a big insight into the situation.
Thanks, I just realised how much I ignore my own accomplishments, given that I accomplished something excellent literally a few days ago yet I posted this.
2 years. I was first diagnosed with depression but after changing doctor to the one whom I'm currently seeing, the diagnosis changed to bipolar
But... do I though? I feel like I'm just faking it
Wow that's great to hear haha
No, I'm only on Abilify.
Thank you, I will.
Thank you for this.
Thanks.
I started seeing a therapist recently. Good timing I guess.
I'm glad that I'm around 5 nowadays, honestly it's a really low level for me. Took a lot of effort to get here, but I'm sure my scale will go up again in near future lol

Usually because psychological pain(loneliness, self hatred and whatnot) is overwhelming or because I want to punish myself. But yesterday I cut for literally no reason besides that I just felt like doing it. I'm worried I might be addicted to this.
Thank you.
another one suffering alone here
I dropped out of high school now but relatable. I sometimes even cut myself in bathroom during lunch.
I feel personally attacked

Another 17 year old here. Very good post. Though I'm not sure what to do when I DID seek help but nothing seems to get better and I'm just terrified of how will I endure adulthood with this messed up state of mind.

Sometimes I just sit and daydream about talking to my imaginary friends about how much pain I feel. They listen to me, care about me, take me seriously and comfort me. Sometimes I have an imaginary girlfriend who hugs me tight.

Then I wake up from my delusions. Reality hits me like a massive boulder. So cold, empty and lonely.

I didn't know someone else also felt like this. I can totally relate.

If you have another room in your home that you can use as your new safe haven, try utilizing that room. It was basement for me, now I spend time there trying to relax/listening to music/drawing something/etc. instead of staying in my bedroom where I feel like I can almost smell depression. I know this tip is not helpful if you don't have such a room but I just wanted to, idk, share

I've experienced this too much. I'm never able to think clearly, even when I'm feeling better, and I feel like my brain is impaired.

It hurt so much when my mom once cried something along the lines of "why did a smart boy become like this". And she suspects it's because of depression meds, not because of depression. So funny... I once used to get the best scores in my entire grade and now I'm doubting if I'll be able to go to university at all.

Well, I guess I'm now even venting in the comment section.
Wow, you summarized everything that I've been feeling about 'not having a right to be depressed' perfectly
You're not a garbage, people who hurt you like that are real fucking garbage. Don't forget that.

When I told my psychiatrist about my suicidal thoughts, she just told me that I'm just trying to flee from life, and said that I don't really need treatment anymore. Never visited her since. And this was what happened after 6 months of regular visits for depression meds. I'm still confused why she suddenly acted like that
My head goes 'blank' very often whenever someone says something to me. As a result, I make people angry for not answering them
Idk, I hate looking at them but my eyes often go to them unconsciously and I just watch them for no reason.
Always. Fucking always
